newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start quietly, soymeal easier.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start quietly, soymeal easier.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market opened the week quietly with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets $1 to $5 lower, following Friday's Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to a few dollars higher on the back of a barely steady dollar. No trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.
"Monday's usuallly start slow. There is little buying mood at the moment due to a lack of faith in the market," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
